types.name: Resin Art
types.description: Handcrafted resin coasters, trays, keychains, clocks and framed florals. Every piece is poured, tinted and polished by hand, so no two are ever identical.
types.leadTimeNote: Resin needs time to cure fully before it is polished and packed.

types.name: Scented Candles
types.description: Small-batch soy-wax candles in jars, pillars and floating votives, poured with gentle fragrances and cotton wicks for a clean, even burn.
types.leadTimeNote: Candles are poured fresh and left to cure so the scent throws well.

types.name: Handmade Soaps
types.description: Cold-process and melt-and-pour soaps enriched with milk, honey, oats, saffron and floral extracts, wrapped beautifully for gifting.
types.leadTimeNote: Soaps are made ahead; custom shapes, scents and gift boxes need a little extra time.
